rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a purplish mark on skin caused by a blow.

example.english: I hit my leg on the table, and now I have a bruise.
example.traditional: 我隻腳撞到張枱，依家有塊瘀青。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 goek3 zong6 dou3 zoeng1 toi2 ji1 gaa1 jau5 faai3 jyu1 cing1

rows.note: Use this for a dark bruise-like mark left on fruit or vegetables after being knocked.

example.english: This apple was knocked and has a bruise on the surface.
example.traditional: 呢個蘋果畀人撞過，表面有條瘀痕。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ping4 gwo2 bei2 jan4 zong6 gwo3 biu2 min6 jau5 tiu4 jyu1 han4
